## Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Long-term brain organoids mirror postnatal epigenetic aging](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41591-026-00044-0)** — *Nature Medicine*
    * Human brain organoids maintained in long-term culture for up to five years demonstrate epigenetic aging dynamics that mirror those observed during in vivo human postnatal brain development.
* **[Parkinson's disease polygenic risk linked to structural brain expansion](https://doi.org/10.64898/2025.12.09.25341901)** — *bioRxiv*
    * Analysis of GWAS and neuroimaging data from ~25,000 UK Biobank participants revealed that higher polygenic risk scores (PRS) for Parkinson's disease (PD) correlate with greater cortical surface area, white matter fractional anisotropy, and subcortical volumes.
    * Mendelian randomization indicates a potential causal relationship from increased brain size to PD risk, with cortical regions experiencing the greatest polygenic surface expansion showing the highest degree of atrophy in clinical PD.
* **[Multimodal machine learning predicts survival in metastatic pancreatic cancer](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.24.26360900)** — *medRxiv*
    * Researchers developed MULTIPL, a multimodal AI platform trained on COMPASS study data (N = 268) integrating clinical, histopathological, genomic, and transcriptomic features.
    * Evaluated in the randomized Phase 2 PASS-01 trial (N = 160) comparing FOLFIRINOX against gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel, MULTIPL achieved a concordance index of 0.595 (95% CI, 0.55–0.65) for overall survival, outperforming single-modality biomarkers in stratifying patient risk.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[CD19 CAR-T cell therapy induces responses in refractory rheumatoid arthritis](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04603-3)** — *Nature Medicine*
    * Phase 1 results from the ongoing COMPARE trial evaluated autologous CD19-targeted CAR-T cell therapy in patients with severe, treatment-refractory seropositive rheumatoid arthritis.
    * The cell therapy was well tolerated, with no unexpected safety signals, and drove clinical improvements across all enrolled trial participants.
* **[Biotech]** **[Phase 2 RETAIN-2 trial reports 77.5% MFS in muscle-invasive bladder cancer](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.24.26361206)** — *medRxiv*
    * The prospective Phase 2 RETAIN-2 trial evaluated neoadjuvant accelerated MVAC plus nivolumab followed by risk-adapted bladder preservation in 71 evaluable patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
    * The study achieved its primary endpoint with a 2-year metastasis-free survival rate of 77.5% at a median follow-up of 34.7 months. Retrospective longitudinal ctDNA dynamics correlated with clinical outcomes in 22 patients managed under active surveillance.
* **[Biotech]** **[Relacorilant combination tested in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42661432/)** — *PubMed*
    * A clinical study evaluated the selective glucocorticoid receptor antagonist relacorilant combined with nab-paclitaxel in adults with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer.
* **[Voice-based AI coach evaluated in Phase 2 trial for depression and anxiety](https://doi.org/10.64898/2025.12.22.25342792)** — *medRxiv*
    * A 3-arm Phase 2 randomized clinical trial (N = 200) tested Lumen, an Alexa-based AI voice coach delivering problem-solving treatment (PST), against human-coached PST and waitlist controls in adults with untreated depression (PHQ-9 10–19) or anxiety (GAD-7 10–14).

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **[AstraZeneca and Ionis detail Phase 3 CARDIO-TTRANSFORM failure of eplontersen](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/astrazeneca-ionis-eplontersen-nejm-cardio-ttransform-results/829057/)** — *NEJM / BioPharma Dive*
    * Full study data published in *The New England Journal of Medicine* detail the Phase 3 failure of the TTR-targeted antisense oligonucleotide eplontersen (Wainua) in transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM).
    * Unlike data reported for Alnylam's siRNA Amvuttra, eplontersen failed to demonstrate statistically significant reductions in cardiovascular events or mortality when added to standard of care, raising mechanistic questions about silencer drug performance in heart disease.
* **[Biotech]** **[Cytokinetics presents positive Phase 3 ACACIA-HCM trial data for aficamten](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/28/cytokinetics-myqorzo-aficamten-nhcm-acacia-trial-success/)** — *STAT+*
    * Cytokinetics released full data from the pivotal Phase 3 ACACIA-HCM study evaluating the selective cardiac myosin inhibitor aficamten (Myqorzo) in nonobstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (nHCM).
    * The trial met its clinical endpoints, demonstrating broad functional efficacy and supporting an upcoming regulatory filing for what could become the company's second approved drug.
* **[Big Pharma]** **[FINEARTS-HF secondary analysis evaluates finerenone by HFpEF risk score](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42663335/)** — *PubMed*
    * A secondary analysis of the Phase 3 FINEARTS-HF trial evaluated the nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist finerenone across baseline patient risk profiles using the HFpEF-ABA score in heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction.
* **[Big Pharma]** **[Analysis questions systemic efficacy of postoperative nivolumab in HNSCC](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)00859-7/fulltext?rss=yes)** — *The Lancet*
    * Clinical commentary on the NIVOPOST-OP trial highlighted a divergence between investigator-assessed disease-free survival (HR = 0.76, 95% CI 0.60–0.98) and blinded central review (HR = 0.89).
    * Authors noted that the apparent DFS signal primarily reflects enhanced locoregional control rather than suppression of distant metastases in high-risk resected head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
* **[Biotech]** **[Quoin Pharmaceuticals reports positive interim Phase 2/3 data for QRX003 in Netherton syndrome](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093278618717753376)** — *BioStocks*
    * An interim analysis of the first six patients completing 12 weeks of treatment in an ongoing Phase 2/3 trial of QRX003 met the pre-specified alpha-adjusted target for the primary endpoint with statistical significance.
    * Alongside the clinical update, the company announced a $50M PIPE financing at $4.88 per ADS.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Biotech]** **[FDA approves Roivant and Priovant's Lisraya for adult dermatomyositis](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-oral-drug-indicated-treat-dermatomyositis-adults)** — *FDA News Release*
    * The FDA approved Lisraya (brepocitinib) tablets, marking the first oral therapy cleared for adult dermatomyositis.
    * Originally discovered by Pfizer and developed by Roivant subsidiary Priovant Therapeutics, the once-daily dual TYK2/JAK1 inhibitor carries a list price of $35,000 for a 30-day supply.
* **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA clears updated COVID-19 vaccines targeting XFG variant](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/fda-covid-vaccines-moderna-generate-profound-bixlenvo/828929/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
    * The FDA granted updated authorizations for Pfizer/BioNTech's Comirnaty mRNA formulation, Moderna's mNEXSPIKE mRNA vaccine, and Novavax's protein-based Nuvaxovid, all tailored to the XFG variant.
    * Approvals maintain limited indications for individuals aged ≥65 and younger individuals at elevated risk for severe COVID-19.
* **[FDA grants Emergency Use Authorization for generic ivermectin in cattle](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-issues-emergency-use-authorization-generic-drug-prevent-new-world-screwworm-cattle)** — *FDA News Release*
    * The agency issued an EUA for Bimectin (ivermectin) injection to prevent New World screwworm infestations in cattle when administered within 24 hours of birth, castration, or wound occurrence.
* **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA approves Eli Lilly's Mounjaro for cardiovascular risk reduction in type 2 diabetes](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093294903526670684)** — *BioStocks*
    * The FDA approved Mounjaro (tirzepatide) to reduce cardiovascular risk in adults with type 2 diabetes.
* **[Big Pharma]** **[B. Braun recalls 0.9% sodium chloride injection due to particulate contamination](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/b-braun-medical-inc-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-09-sodium-chloride-injection-usp-100-ml-150)** — *FDA*
    * B. Braun Medical voluntarily recalled three lots of 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection USP (100 mL in a 150 mL PAB container) nationwide.
    * The recall was triggered by the discovery of particulate matter identified as zinc oxide.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **[Moderna prices upsized $2.6B public offering for oncology work](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/fda-covid-vaccines-moderna-generate-profound-bixlenvo/828929/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
    * Moderna closed an upsized public financing raising $2.6 billion in fresh capital to support its expanding oncology clinical development pipeline.
* **[Biotech market recovery driven by accelerated IPO and M&A activity](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/biotech-charts-biopharma-xbi-deals-mergers-ipos/828794/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
    * The SPDR S&P Biotech ETF (XBI) has nearly doubled over the past 12 months, recovering from a low of $64 per share.
    * Industry momentum is backed by 20 biotech initial public offerings completed in 2026 to date—nearly double the 11 recorded in all of 2025—alongside stronger transaction valuations in M&A.
* **[Biotech]** **[BioXcel Therapeutics files for bankruptcy with proposed Teva asset acquisition](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093280043346567175)** — *BioStocks*
    * BioXcel Therapeutics filed for bankruptcy and entered into an asset sale agreement with Teva Pharmaceutical Industries.
    * If designated the successful bidder, Teva will acquire worldwide rights to BioXcel's assets, including dexmedetomidine, for $57.5M upfront and up to $67.5M in potential contingent payments.
* **[Biotech]** **[Kazia Therapeutics prices $120M offering](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093300547461804045)** — *BioStocks*
    * Kazia Therapeutics priced an offering of $120M at $15.50 per ADS.

## Public Health & Policy

* **[Executive leadership changes at the WHO and CDC](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01756-3/fulltext?rss=yes)** — *The Lancet*
    * Jeremy Farrar announced his unexpected departure as WHO Assistant Director-General of Health Promotion, Disease Prevention and Care.
    * Newly appointed CDC Director Erica Schwartz publicly addressed agency staff, committing to defend routine vaccination schedules and support workforce stability.
* **[Legislative surge targets US immunization rules](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01616-8/fulltext?rss=yes)** — *The Lancet*
    * US state legislatures considered more than 400 vaccine-related bills between August 2025 and July 2026, with 209 seeking to weaken immunization requirements or public health oversight; only nine were signed into law.
* **[Federal autism advisory committee meeting dominated by vaccine debates](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/28/vaccines-autism-advisory-committee-strategic-plan-boost-research-funding/)** — *STAT+*
    * A federal committee meeting assembled to update strategic planning for autism research funding was largely overshadowed by public comments and debates surrounding vaccine safety.
* **[Modeling study projects Medicare financial impact of multi-cancer blood tests](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.24.26361257)** — *medRxiv*
    * Researchers modeled the economic cost to Medicare following federal mandates requiring coverage of FDA-approved Multi-Cancer Detection (MCD) tests, incorporating direct screening costs and downstream diagnostic workups resulting from false-positive results.

**Worth watching:** The stark outcome divergence between AstraZeneca/Ionis's eplontersen and Alnylam's Amvuttra in ATTR-CM Phase 3 trials will likely trigger intense scrutiny over whether subtle differences in gene-silencer tissue distribution, chemistry, or patient subgroup selection drive clinical efficacy in amyloid heart disease.

- Biology & Health
    - [Why Hyperscalers Won’t Make AI Models Cheaper](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/qMXx785oYLE) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Dr. Thomas Kelly analyzes hyperscaler business models and artificial intelligence pricing strategies.
        - Hyperscalers are disincentivized from introducing cheaper AI models to avoid cannibalizing high-margin revenue from enterprise clients.
        - Premium pricing remains sustainable because large business customers are willing to pay top rates for enterprise-grade AI capabilities.
    - [Is the Cash-Pay Healthcare Market Disappearing?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Zf9sbNja3HE) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Analyst Stephanie Davis evaluates the implications of BetterHelp's substantial revenue guidance reduction.
        - The guidance cut serves as a key indicator of a shrinking cash-pay healthcare market.
        - Consumer spending pullbacks are driving structural revenue challenges for direct-to-consumer digital health platforms.
    - [Digital Health Vitals, Ep. 10: Epic UGM2026, Teladoc Earnings, Commure Investigation & Oracle Health](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=efy1sP_pe3o) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Analysis of Q2 healthtech earnings highlights Teladoc's ongoing revenue struggles against Talkspace's growth, alongside Doximity beating Wall Street expectations despite potential competition from OpenEvidence.
        - Epic UGM 2026 coverage focuses on Epic's expanding EHR market dominance, its Cosmos predictive analytics platform, and ambient AI integration competing against Abridge, Microsoft, and Nuance.
        - Oracle Health's post-Cerner acquisition trajectory is evaluated in the context of the contested Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) EHR modernization project.
        - The panel reviews the Stat investigation into Commure's referral fee practices alongside R1's strategic acquisitions aimed at AI-native revenue cycle management (RCM) and automated prior authorization.
- Pure Science
    - [Traduire un message extraterrestre grâce au langage des mathématiques ? - CJVC #2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tN4ppSR3o28) -- El Jj
        - Explores mathematical translation concepts through the mechanics of the video game "The Message from Deep Space."
        - Demonstrates how alien messages are decoded using positional base-8 (octal) numerical systems in Transmission 10 and integer sequences like the Fibonacci sequence in Transmission 15.
        - Details the application of Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) for evaluating arithmetic expressions in Transmission 14 and functional equations in Transmission 74.
